pairs.subject: retrieval
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/chunker.rs:138 The knowledge-base chunker in this context cuts every source, .md included, into fixed max_chars windows. It only looks back up to 100 chars for a sentence break and otherwise falls back to the raw character count. It ignores headings, paragraphs and list items and always adds overlap. That is the arithmetic, overlap-by-default cut that chunking-and-indexing names as the failure mode.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/chunker.rs:142 Boundaries are a character count with a 100-char sentence lookback; when no break is found the cut lands mid-sentence or mid-word, and no source's structural seams (headings, paragraphs) are used. Overlap is applied unconditionally (line 161: `start = actual_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);`). No runt floor merges tiny chunks. Partly conformant: provenance carries the page and extraction_confidence (line 52), and zero-yield pages are counted (line 27, empty_pages/unreadable_pages).
